title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
This page reports the live paper record as it stands. Every position in it is paper, and no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A single trade says nothing about a strategy. The early live results are a losing start, and the testing expectation already allowed for that.

## Paper only, and one trade is not a verdict

The framing comes first. Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The initial live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. NEAR entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 and has been open since. In testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The point of the framing is simple: the record is a log of paper signals, and a single closed trade does not prove or disprove either engine.

## Open positions on the live record

At the snapshot read at 2026-11-08T20:48:00.755Z, htf-rsi-v007 had 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 had 0 positions open on paper and 6 closed trades so far, with average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 had 0 positions open on paper and 7 closed trades so far, with average -13.34% net per trade. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 remains open. There are no other open positions in this record. The measurement is the open count, and the recorded open count is 0 for each engine at that snapshot. A 0 open count means no paper position is currently held by that engine; it does not say when the next signal will arrive.

## Closed trades so far

ATOM is the most recent closed trade described in detail. The entry was at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The exit rule fired because the close was below the 10-day low, and the exit price was 1.703 at the 18 October 2026 close. The measured result is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The engine-level closed-trade counts are 4 for htf-rsi-v007, 6 for trend-daily-v005, and 7 for trend-daily-v006. The corresponding average net results are null for htf-rsi-v007, -13.22% for trend-daily-v005, and -13.34% for trend-daily-v006. These are recorded outcomes from paper signals. They are not a forecast, and they do not establish that any engine will keep producing the same result. The cause is the price path; the measurement is the exit price against the entry price.

## What the market filter is allowing

Both trend-daily engines show the Bitcoin market filter off at this snapshot. With the filter off, trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 have 0 positions open on paper. The closest names to their 20-day breakout are ZECUSDT at 4.65% below its high, UNIUSDT at 5.26% below its high, and BNBUSDT at 8.38% below its high. These distances are measurements of how far each name is from its breakout level. They are not entry signals, and they do not say when or whether a position will open. htf-rsi-v007 is not described here as having a Bitcoin market filter. The filter state and the open count are both part of the same live snapshot, and the record shows 0 open positions while the filter is off.

## Where the same numbers appear

The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The snapshot used here was read at 2026-11-08T20:48:00.755Z. Because every position is paper, the record describes signals and outcomes on paper only. It does not describe real orders, real fills, or real capital. If a position opens or closes after that snapshot, the live record will show the new state, and the same numbers will appear in the places listed above.
